The missing row is iBabs / iBabs bestuursportaal (Not vuln), in software_list_i.md, whose Links cell is empty, which is probably why the export parser skipped it. data/software.json (count 674, Not vuln 3) and raw/software-list-cca173c64ec5.json carry the error.
